newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Minmetals to issue 75 mln A shares in May.
newsitem.headline: China's Minmetals to issue 75 mln A shares in May.

text.p: China's Minmetals Development Co Ltd plans to make an initial public offering of 75 million A shares and list them in Shanghai on May 5, an company official said on Wednesday.
The firm's parent company, the China National Metals and Minerals Import and Export Co, would hold 75 percent of the shares, the official said by telephone.
Net profit of Minmetals Development was 115 million yuan ($13.8 million) in 1996, up from 106 million yuan the year before, he said.
Total foreign trade of Minmetals was expected to reach two billion yuan by the year 2000, and post-tax profit was seen at 300 million yuan, he said.
Minmetals had six wholly owned subsidiaries, he said, but gave no further details.
